dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Hi. I'd like to book a table for tonight, please.
dialogue.reading: ˈhaɪ. aɪd ˈlaɪk tə ˈbʊk ə ˈteɪbəl fər təˈnaɪt, ˈpliːz.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: A table for two, at seven o'clock.
dialogue.reading: ə ˈteɪbəl fər ˈtuː, ət ˈsɛvən əˈklɑːk.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: Would you prefer a table inside or an outdoor table?
dialogue.reading: wʊd juː prɪˈfɜːr ə ˈteɪbəl ˌɪnˈsaɪd ɔːr ən ˈaʊtdɔːr ˈteɪbəl?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: I'd rather sit outside. It's cooler in the evening.
dialogue.reading: aɪd ˈræðər ˈsɪt ˌaʊtˈsaɪd. ɪts ˈkuːlər ɪn ði ˈiːvnɪŋ.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: I'm sorry. The outdoor tables are fully booked at seven.
dialogue.reading: aɪm ˈsɑːri. ði ˈaʊtdɔːr ˈteɪbəlz ər ˈfʊli ˈbʊkt ət ˈsɛvən.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Oh no. What about eight o'clock?
dialogue.reading: ˈoʊ ˈnoʊ. ˈwʌt əˈbaʊt ˈeɪt əˈklɑːk?

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: There's one outdoor table at eight. Or I can put you on the waiting list for seven.
dialogue.reading: ðɛrz ˈwʌn ˈaʊtdɔːr ˈteɪbəl ət ˈeɪt. ɔːr aɪ kən ˈpʊt juː ɑːn ðə ˈweɪtɪŋ ˌlɪst fər ˈsɛvən.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: I'd prefer the table at eight, please. My name is Nam.
dialogue.reading: aɪd prɪˈfɜːr ðə ˈteɪbəl ət ˈeɪt, ˈpliːz. maɪ ˈneɪm ɪz ˈnɑːm.
